notes.title: Now Released!
notes.content:
Hello. This is Misato from Ou Denkei.

cursed letter　

We have just released it a few minutes ago.
Sorry for the wait, and thank you for your patience.

I hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: The road to release and thank you.
notes.content:
Hello. Nice to meet you, my name is Misato (奥羽電影のみさと).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203393/df66790bf6365cb5b5aebb9741e0f05d3009266e.gif[/img]
Let me start by saying thank you.

[b]Wishlist registrations have surpassed 70!
Thank you so much for your interest in this game. [/b]

Also, I would like to thank [url=https://www.4gamer.net/games/838/G083866/20240917051/]4gamer[/url] for writing the article.

We are very happy that our first game to be released on Steam has received so much attention.


And while we're on the subject, the app is currently awaiting review, and if all goes well, we should be able to release it within the next week.

If we run into any problems, we'll let you know here, on [url=https://x.com/OUDENEI]X[/url], and on [url=https://ko-fi.com/misato310]ko-fi[/url] as soon as possible.

We hope you will wait a while longer for the release.

Also, since this is our first release, many problems may occur and we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We will try to respond as quickly as possible, and we appreciate your patience.

That's all for now.

We are planning to release many more games in the future, so we would appreciate it if you would pay attention to them as well.

We look forward to your continued support.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
